cases.name: all_background_was_accepted
cases.reason: The baseline self_check returned success for an all-background grid via the undeclared no_path texture branch.

cases.name: singleton_only_was_accepted
cases.reason: A singleton is not the required two-path/two-marker scene, but the baseline validator accepted it.

cases.name: unknown_override_was_silently_ignored
cases.reason: Silent acceptance made exact controls unauditable and allowed misspelled axes to change no behavior.

cases.name: canonical_multiturn_scene_was_outside_the_L_only_model
cases.reason: The canonical family contains a three-turn simple path; the baseline summary and sampler modeled only one-turn L paths.
